Constructed movie queue buffer at movie+0x8684 aliases the small local destructor pointer. Constructor42d4a0 clears it; both preceding calls to original4f0120 either see an inactive movie with no queue or call4f1490, which deletes and zeros this buffer at4f14d3. Its loop uses the saved positive count and each4f13c0(1) success decrements count exactly once, so its early-failure guards cannot occur for the constructed queue with normal allocator release semantics. The second cleanup skips after movie+4 is cleared. The nine-byte duplicate delete is unreachable in this returning constructed-object domain; no physical fixture may manufacture a queue pointer after cleanup.

equivalent_mutants.reason: In the ordinary returning 0x42b140 contract, base+0x34 is movie+0x18. Original 0x4f0000 writes the supplied surface there at 0x4f0037 before any downstream use. Its three early rejection branches leave movie+4 inactive, so cleanup 0x4f0120 skips all member reads. Missing graphics takes the same inactive cleanup. This store spills the already loaded interface into base+0x10, an unescaped ordinary stack temporary. Native subsequent logic uses the local interface value, never that slot. Original 0x42b27c stores this temporary and reloads it before the call, while later cleanup overwrites it at 0x42b339/0x42b36b or 0x42b3e6. Omitting the redundant native spill cannot change arguments, return, live memory, lifetime or physical events; full stack/exception-state parity is not this ordinary ABI.

The immediately preceding unchanged 0x4f0120 call either sees inactive movie+4 or completes cleanup and clears movie+4 at 0x4f013e. There is no intervening service or store. The second original call at 0x42b322 consequently takes 0x4f0128 -> 0x4f017c and returns without effects. Its return value is unused. Deleting this duplicate no-op preserves all ordinary observations.

The exact shift moves the final local array destructor from helper+0x138 to helper+0x13c. The helper constructor zeros both candidate buffer fields. If activated, preceding helper cleanup 0x4efcd0 calls 0x4f5915 with size zero, which frees and clears +4/+8/+0xc at 0x4f593a-0x4f5940; inactive construction leaves those fields zero. Thus both destructor receivers issue the same delete(null), and only the discarded stack vtable position changes. This proof is for the owned returning 0x42b140 path, not arbitrary standalone array destructors.

This swap is in the missing-graphics arm only: the freshly constructed helper has first word zero and has never been activated through 0x4f02e0. Original 0x4efcd0 therefore immediately skips at 0x4efcd6 to 0x4efcf2 without a service or store. Moving that no-op across the unchanged local array destructor preserves the physical delete(null) and every ordinary output.

This omitted file-member destructor is in the missing-graphics arm only. Constructor 0x4f72c9 initializes the handle to -1 at 0x4f72ec and its CString via 0x4f6439 to the shared empty singleton; original globals 0x52e1cc=0x52e1c4 and 0x52e1c8=0x52e1b8 satisfy data-12=header. No file open occurs in this arm. Destructor 0x4f7369 skips close at 0x4f738b, and CString release 0x4f6584 skips atomic/free at 0x4f6592 for that singleton. It only updates a discarded local vtable and restores its exception frame. In the ordinary returning contract with valid CRT singleton state, omitting it changes no physical events, live memory, lifetimes or return; this is not an exemption for active file destruction.

Original 0x4f57c5 is a leaf constructor writing only the disjoint twenty-byte member at receiver+0x138 through +0x148, with no calls or input reads. Swapping it with the zero store to receiver+0 therefore commutes for every valid backed receiver, including standalone heap instances. Both complete before the following physical time service. No initial-zero assumption is used.

ABI correction 2026-10-21 (level-one-state-handler-abi-01): 0x4bb030 (return zero) is the LS_HOME and LS_IDLE handler of state table 0x537638 (kind 0x1 rows of Sources/LogicStateRegistry.cpp) and a shared virtual slot, and the original state dispatchers and virtual calls reach it with the object in ECX and no stack arguments. The original body ignores ECX, reads no stack argument and ends in a plain ret, so thiscall with no arguments describes it exactly as well as cdecl with none, and it is the declaration under which the native dispatch accepts its callers' receiver.
